Ritika Banka

Senior Analyst

+91- 8446677468 | ritikabanka24@gmail.com| Mumbai, INDIA | Experience: 1 Year 07 Months |

Profile summary

Detail-oriented Senior Analyst with over 1 year 7 months of experience in OTC Derivatives Operations, specializing in Interest Rate Swaps (IRS). Experienced in trade lifecycle management, trade confirmations, rate reset drafting, OTC reconciliations and cash flow settlements. Proven ability to investigate trade exceptions, validate trade economics, and coordinate with front/middle office and counterparties to ensure timely processing and reduce operational risk. Currently pursuing an MBA in Finance to deepen expertise in capital markets and risk management.

Skills

Interest Rate Swaps (IRS)

Counterparty Coordination

Risk & Controls

Process Automation

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Office

Work Experience

Senior Analyst – eClerx

Supported the end-to-end lifecycle of OTC Interest Rate Swap (IRS) trades, including trade capture and confirmation

through settlement and maturity.

Performed rate reset drafting, trade confirmations, and cash flow settlement activities while ensuring compliance with

internal controls and client SLAs.

Executed OTC trade reconciliation by validating trade economics, cash flows, and positions across internal systems and

counterparties to identify and resolve breaks.

Collaborated with front office, middle office, settlements, and counterparties to ensure timely trade processing and

accurate lifecycle events.

Assisted in margin and collateral-related processes to maintain operational accuracy and reduce settlement risk.

Monitored trade exceptions, investigated discrepancies, and ensured prompt resolution to minimize counterparty and

operational risk.

Contributed to process improvements by identifying automation opportunities and maintaining audit-ready documentation.
